abstract: A 57-year-old female patient with known cardiac disease developed a 4 to 6 week history of diarrhea, followed by onset of orthopnea and subsequent right-sided cardiac failure. On hospital admission she was found to have pure tricuspid regurgitation, without evidence of cardiac ischemia, pulmonary embolism, bacterial endocarditis or pericardial disease. A 24-hour urine collection for 5-HIAA was elevated, and a subsequent octreotide scan documented abnormal uptake in the pelvic cul-de-sac. Bilateral ovarian masses were found at laparotomy, which on pathological examination were found to be a benign left ovarian cystic teratoma, and a right carcinoid tumor of the ovary. This patient presented with systemic complaints of diarrhea, and orthopnea and right sided heart failure that on evaluation were ultimately found to be due to a unilateral primary carcinoid tumor of the ovary, which accounts for less than 0.1% of all ovarian carcinomas, and only 5% of all carcinoids. Treatment of this malignant carcinoid syndrome presentation consisted of debulking of the tumor and continuation of her diuretics and digoxin. Diarrhea and orthopnea ceased within 2 weeks after her oophorectomy. On evaluation 6 weeks and 6 months postoperatively, her cardiac function was stable, though unchanged. 5-HIAA levels were within normal limits, demonstrating the curative function of surgery in patients with unilateral ovarian carcinoid without evidence of metastases, as well as preserved cardiac function in otherwise stable patients.
abstract_ja: 57歳女性で既知の心疾患があり、4～6週間の下痢の後に起座呼吸と続いて右心不全を発症した。入院時に純粋な三尖弁逆流が認められたが、心虚血、肺塞栓、細菌性心内膜炎、心膜疾患の所見はなかった。24時間尿中5-HIAAが上昇しており、その後のオクトレオチドスキャンで骨盤のダグラス窩に異常集積が認められた。開腹手術で両側の卵巣腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的に良性の左卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と右卵巣カルチノイド腫瘍と判明した。本症例は、下痢、起座呼吸、右心不全という全身症状を呈したが、評価の結果、単側性の原発性卵巣カルチノイド腫瘍によるものと判明した。卵巣カルチノイドは全卵巣癌の0.1%未満、全カルチノイドの5%に過ぎない稀な腫瘍である。悪性カルチノイド症候群の治療として腫瘍減量術と利尿薬およびジゴキシンの継続を行った。下痢と起座呼吸は卵巣摘出術後2週間以内に消失した。術後6週間および6か月の評価で、心機能は安定していたが不変であった。本症例は、転移のない単側性卵巣カルチノイドに対する手術の根治的効果と、他に安定した患者における心機能の保持を示している。
